COMBINED PLAN POSITION 1 (epoch:planned-combined-plan-reflow2-and-flo2, agreed 2026-09-27). Items 1 and 2 below are merged (#605, #606); item 3 merged in #607 (83c63ec, chg:an-http-server-drains-before-it-stops-2026-09-27) on @ajs's word ("merge 607, then start on #2"). All three shipped in v0.73.0 (rel:v0730, cut 2026-09-28); flo2.io runs them once its engine is upgraded to 0.73.0.

Planned 2026-09-27 on @ajs's word ("Yes, let's build the now items in reflow2"). These are the engine-side "now" items of flo2's proposed dec:idea-the-scaling-path-checked-against-current-practice, built as separate PRs in this order:
1. req:a-hosted-server-closes-idle-designs-and-says-busy-when-full (cap:graph-registry): an idle timeout, least-recently-used reuse at the limit, 503 instead of 404, no reopen until the old copy releases its store, and sessions ended on close.
2. req:one-open-design-costs-a-deliberate-amount-of-memory: one block cache and write-buffer budget shared across a server's open stores, measured before and after.
3. req:a-server-drains-before-it-stops (cap:a-server-drains-before-it-stops).

The fourth "now" item, backups without stopping the server, keeps its own epoch (epoch:planned-backups-without-stopping-the-server) and needs a flo2 change to ops/flo2-backup as well.

This epoch is NOT ordered within the tracked-export retirement plan (steps 1 to 8); nothing there waits on it. It is what lets flo2.io's single engine grow with the number of designs IN USE rather than the number that exist. Until flo2.io runs 0.73.0, the open-design limit (64 on flo2.io since 2026-09-27) must exceed the total number of designs.

ARRIVED 2026-09-28: all three items shipped in the v0.73.0 cut (rel:v0730, pinned to the next epoch, epoch:planned-a-code-folder-names-its-design, which this one PRECEDES). The three ChangeEvents (the-registry-closes-idle-designs, every-open-store-shares-one-memory-budget, an-http-server-drains-before-it-stops) are pinned here, so the rel:v0720..rel:v0730 changelog window covers them. Anthony: "ok, cut 0.73.0 once they're done".
properties.name: [Combined 1] The hosted engine closes idle designs, says busy when full, keeps a chosen memory budget, and drains before it stops
